engine: own build strata-xtx xtx-2 on Strata 0.2.17 (engine 0.1.63)
card: RX 7900 XTX in the dock, modes quiet (2,800 MHz, -100 mV) and max

files.IQ3_XXS (in use): my own ISTA GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS file, 75.8 GB, fits into VRAM + RAM
files.UD-IQ4_XS: Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS, 93.7 GB (55 GiB of experts)
files.UD-Q4_K_XL: Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL, 111 GB (72 GiB of experts)

method: per version: load, short answer, tool call, 2 x 900 tokens decode after warm-up, prompts of 4K/16K/58K tokens with a hidden number, a follow-up question after the 58K text, image input for the uncensored version. NVMe bytes read and the lowest available RAM sampled per step. The engine streams what the GPU cache and the RAM budget (--resident-budget-gib) do not hold from the pack on the NVMe pool (2 x 2 TB, RAID 1).
